description: Defines the UploadFileElementReader class, an implementation of UploadElementReader for handling file uploads, including methods for initialization, reading, and managing file info within the net namespace.

classes.name: UploadFileElementReader
classes.description: An implementation of UploadElementReader for reading files to be uploaded, supporting asynchronous operations and file info management.

methods.name: UploadFileElementReader
methods.description: Constructors for initializing the reader with a file or file path, range offsets, and expected modification time.

methods.name: path
methods.description: Returns the file path associated with this upload element.

methods.name: range_offset
methods.description: Returns the offset within the file from which reading begins.

methods.name: range_length
methods.description: Returns the length of the data to be read from the file.

methods.name: expected_modification_time
methods.description: Returns the expected last modification time of the file.

methods.name: AsFileReader
methods.description: Returns a pointer to this object if it is a file reader.

methods.name: GetContentLength
methods.description: Returns the total content length to be uploaded.

methods.name: BytesRemaining
methods.description: Returns the number of bytes remaining to be read.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data into the provided buffer asynchronously.
